title: Sentier mappings bridge metadata
description: Identity file (metadata.json) carried by each data/<NN>-<source>__<target>/ bridge folder.

source.description: Lower-kebab source datasource id, e.g. agribalyse-3.2.

target.description: Lower-kebab target datasource id, e.g. ecoinvent-3.9.1, ef-3.1, or a Sentier source.

rank.description: Resolution precedence; lower wins on conflict.

kinds.description: Which package files are present in this bridge.

target_proprietary.description: true ⇒ targets are opaque codes only (ecoinvent); false ⇒ full open identifiers.
